cumleler: Why does a hearing aid give loud sounds less gain?
In cochlear loss, thresholds rise but discomfort levels often stay the same.
Here, a soft 40 dB sound gets 35 dB of gain.
At a 70 dB input, gain drops to 25 dB.
For a loud 90 dB sound, gain is only 15 dB.
So a 50 dB input range fits into 30 dB of output.
